summary: Task 2 implementation faithfully matches Decision 4 (verbatim detectBrowserLanguage shape, no cookieMaxAge — verified absent in @nuxtjs/i18n@9.5.6 DetectBrowserLanguageOptions), Decision 14 (Object.fromEntries map over NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES with shared AUTH_HEADERS named constant prevents header-drift), and stub locale parity (Task 4 prebuild script will pass). Module bootstrap is clean; no critical/major findings.

findings.issue: silentTranslationWarn / silentFallbackWarn are vue-i18n Legacy-mode option names. With legacy: false (Composition mode, line 2) the active runtime path is createComposer, which reads missingWarn / fallbackWarn instead. Grep of the installed vue-i18n@10.0.8 esm-bundler runtime and @nuxtjs/i18n@9.5.6 dist shows zero references to silentTranslationWarn/silentFallbackWarn in the runtime code path — these flags are silently dropped under legacy:false, so Decision 9 / AC14 'no info disclosure через console' is not actually enforced at runtime in production. Implementation is spec-faithful (tech-spec line 119 + task line 43 explicitly name silentTranslationWarn/silentFallbackWarn), so this is a spec-level concern, not an implementer mistake. Reported as minor for downstream awareness — fix would itself be a deviation requiring approval.
findings.fix: Out of Task 2 scope. For follow-up: either (a) add a User-Spec Deviation entry and switch to missingWarn / fallbackWarn (the Composition-mode equivalents, both typed boolean | RegExp), or (b) accept that the legacy flags are aspirational and rely on the build-gate (check-locales.mjs in Task 4) as the sole guard.

Rest of the frontend codebase (frontend/composables/useApi.ts, frontend/middleware/auth.global.ts, the new frontend/nuxt.config.ts edits, frontend/i18n/i18n.config.ts) follows no-semicolon style. Two-line file but inconsistent with project convention.
